name: wechat-lead-hub
description: Open-source WeChat lead reception platform for telemarketing funnels (service + subscription accounts, channel QR, H5 capture, third-party transfer)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix web && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.setup: cp server/.env.example server/.env && npm run install:all && npm run build
